claims.quote: Our consulting operations team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that your consulting operations team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we align with your needs, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting to clarify what you need from Cedar Systems.

During this meeting, we can discuss your workflow coordination and account reporting requirements, and determine the best path forward. Please let us know a convenient time to proceed.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the expected timeline for identifying a project owner?
Are there any specific departments or teams that will be involved in this project?

The need for clarification on requirements may affect the scheduling of the discovery meeting.
